Hello

— I'm Athiramol, an SEO Specialist

My Story

I discovered my interest in digital marketing while working on SEO, content optimisation, and improving website visibility. Watching search rankings grow and organic traffic increase made me curious about how search engines work and how users actually find content online.

That curiosity led me to focus more on keyword research, competitor analysis, and data-driven SEO strategies. I enjoy understanding search behaviour and creating content that connects with real users while improving performance in search engines.

Currently, I'm a Digital Marketing Intern at Intelercs in the UK, where I continue building hands-on experience in SEO strategy, search analysis, and content optimisation — with a simple goal: helping websites grow organically and reach the right audience.
